subject: Mosaic alliance: cross-border sprint plan & integration constraints
messages:
From: Sam Chen <sam.chen@mosaic-sys.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: partners@globaledge.io
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Mosaic x Redwood: cross-border integration kickoff

Vanessa —

Great to connect last week. Mosaic is keen to run a focused integration sprint with Redwood to validate local SI workflows and confirm data path controls for EU and APAC customers. High-level asks:

- Verify that requests originating in EU/DE and APAC/JP can be routed to local SI enclaves while keeping PII and KV cache data pinned to region.
- Validate KMS integrations (customer-managed keys in EU) and an audit log export for SOC 2 evidence.
- Short sprint to demo end-to-end telemetry and a fallback policy when the local enclave is unavailable.

Proposed week: Dec 7–11 (3 dev days + 2 ops runbooks). Can Redwood support a pre-sprint tech sync on Dec 3 (30–45m)? I attached a rough scope.

Attachments: [Attachment: Mosaic_Sprint_scope_v0.1.pdf (pdf, 180KB)]

Thanks — Sam
Sam Chen
Head of Partnerships, Mosaic Systems
sam.chen@mosaic-sys.com
+44 7700 111222
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Chen <sam.chen@mosaic-sys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, hiro_tanaka@redwoodinference.com, sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-30T12:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mosaic x Redwood: cross-border integration kickoff

Sam —

Thanks for the clear scope. Dec 7–11 looks workable; we can do the tech pre-sync on Dec 3 at 09:00 GMT (I’ll send a calendar invite). For the pre-sync we’ll cover 

- data path diagram and how prefix/KV caching behaves across regions
- KMS options (Redwood-hosted vs customer-managed in EU)
- rollout and fallback policy (automatic model variant fallback + traffic routing)

I’ve attached a first-pass SOW and a quick data-path sketch for the team to review.

Immediate asks for Dec 3:
- Sam: confirm which EU/JP partners will be in the sprint and provide contact for legal (for SOW redlines).
- Marissa: pricing for a 5-day engineering sprint + 90-day validation support.
- Hiro: list of runtime/OS images we’ll need to replicate for local SI partners.

Attachments: [Attachment: Mosaic_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (pdf, 220KB)], [Attachment: data_path_sketch.png (png, 45KB)]

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, hiro_tanaka@redwoodinference.com, sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-01T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: mosaic sprint prep — compliance & ops flags

Team — quick alignment note before the sync with Mosaic on Dec 3. Please reply inline with ownership and ETA.

1) Data residency patterns (owner: Marissa)
- Option A: requests routed and processed entirely inside partner-managed enclave (preferred for regulated customers).
- Option B: prefix/KV cached locally but model execution in Redwood hosted zone with encrypted transit.
- Deliverable: one-paragraph recommended default + fallback policy by EOD Dec 2.

2) KMS + key escrow (owner: Hiro)
- Confirm if we can accept a partner-hosted CMK in EU via our KMS abstraction and whether HSM attestation is required.
- Deliverable: compatibility matrix + any infra changes by Dec 4.

3) Audit logs & evidence (owner: Sergio)
- Need an export pipeline that produces immutable audit bundles (S3 link) for SOC 2 review. Include log format and retention.
- Deliverable: sample export & retention policy notes by Dec 4.

4) Pricing and SOW terms (owner: Marissa)
- Draft day-rate + validation window + support retainer. Flag any non-standard T&Cs.

5) Runbook + fallback (owner: Vanessa)
- Who owns DNS/route failover vs model variant fallback? Need decision matrix for canary -> full failover.

Add any other compliance flags you see. We’ll review before the external call.

- Van
From: Legal Team <legal@mosaic-sys.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sam.chen@mosaic-sys.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-02T14:22:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Mosaic x Redwood: cross-border integration kickoff — SOW redlines

Vanessa / Sam —

Thanks for the SOW. A few redlines from Mosaic legal – summary below and in-line in the attached draft.

- Data residency: we require explicit language that customer data and cache artifacts for EU customers remain within EU jurisdiction unless we provide written consent.
- KMS: Mosaic will insist on customer-managed keys for EU production customers; need to confirm Redwood’s acceptance of CMKs and the key-rotation process.
- Liability: remove the blanket limitation for downstream partner mishandling (we need a carve-out for gross negligence).
- Audit evidence: require 90 days of immutable audit bundles on request with a 7-day turnaround for exports.

We attached our marked-up SOW. Please confirm which of the above are feasible so we can finalize.

Attachments: [Attachment: Mosaic_SOW_redlines_v1.pdf (pdf, 80KB)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Chen <sam.chen@mosaic-sys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, hiro_tanaka@redwoodinference.com, sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-03T16:47:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Mosaic x Redwood: cross-border integration kickoff — confirmed

Sam / Mosaic legal —

Appreciate the quick redlines. Short answers up front:

- Data residency: we can commit to regionally pinned cache and an option for partner-hosted enclave processing for regulated customers. We will add explicit jurisdictional language for EU in the SOW.
- KMS: Redwood supports integration with partner/customer CMKs via our KMS abstraction; Hiro will confirm rotation/attestation details by EOD Dec 4.
- Audit bundles: we can produce immutable audit exports; Sergio will scope the export pipeline and confirm the 7-day turnaround requirement.
- Liability: Marissa will follow up with draft language for a carve-out and pricing impact.

Next steps and owners: 
- Dec 3 (tomorrow) 09:00 GMT: technical pre-sync (Zoom invite sent).
- Dec 4: internal deliverables (Hiro, Sergio, Marissa) to finalize implementation notes and pricing.
- Dec 7–11: sprint week (onsite/remote to be confirmed).

Relevant artifacts: Drive folder for SOW + runbooks: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cMosaicSprint
Jira epic: EPIC-4521 (sprint tracking).

We’ll treat Mosaic as a pilot partner for the cross-border pattern — keep escalation paths open and loop in Legal if new clauses appear.

—Vanessa
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
